sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of form (W-D-W-W-W), travel away to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a fixture they should approach as strong favourites: Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six matches, having lost their last four games. Sandbach's dominant position and recent consistency make them clear contenders for the title.
divisionWide: Title challengers Stafford Town (second place, 20 points) face a home fixture against Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, providing an opportunity to narrow the gap on Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a meeting of sides in strong league positions; Eccleshall sit fifth but have lost their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) welcome basement club Widnes Town at home—Widnes have collected just 2 points all season and remain winless. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table contest. Barnton (seventh, 15 points) entertain Shawbury United, who are struggling with five losses in their last six games. New Mills face Market Drayton Town in a mid-lower-table clash; both sides have picked up recent wins but remain in challenging positions. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a bottom-half encounter, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town—both sides have been inconsistent, though Telford's recent form shows just one win in their last nine outings. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town to complete the weekend's fixtures.
